results.title: Netizens divided on alleged Vice Ganda-Heart Evangelista snubbing incident
results.description: A hot topic in social media as of the moment is the alleged snubbing incident involving Vice Ganda and Heart Evangelista. Talk has it that the two did not acknowledge each other at Yeng Constantino’s 20th-anniversary concert at the Araneta Coliseum on August 29. A video uploaded by a netizen shows Vice happily greeting everyone in their row but not Heart. Heart was very near Vice, right next to Ryan Bang, but it seems that both didn't see each other. Or did they? Fans are actually divided about it. Some suggested that it wasn't intentional on either Vice or Heart's part. However, there are those who insist there is bad blood between the two due to Vice being critical of a school in Sorsogon, which he said was lacking in reading materials and needed repairs. At the time, Vice identifed Sorsogon as "probinsiya nina Heart."

results.title: Lead Engineer VOS
results.description: In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Participate in the handover meeting and discuss with sales and project management team on the project requirements and any deviations. Create a project timeline, notify the stakeholders, identify risks, and take appropriate action to reduce them. Drive the team to create wiring, schematic, and general arrangement drawings in accordance with the project specification Review manufacturing designs and the bill of materials Drive the team to meet their KPIs like RDSL, Quality, etc. working toward the goal. Prepare project metrics and review them weekly/monthly with higher management. Investigate and resolve operational problems from an engineering perspective. Encourage the team to put the needs of the customer foremost by understanding and meeting those demands with high Quality of Deliverables. Develop / Create standards in line with engineering processes and procedures Create work instructions to describe engineering best practices. Define goals and objectives for the team and review periodically Co-ordinate with cross-function departments Drive continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance quality and productivity of deliverables Who You Are: You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly act in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain. You understand internal and external stakeholder requirements, expectations, and needs. You keep a strong bottom-line orientation. You come up with useful ideas that are new, better, or unique, introducing new ways of looking at problems. You ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations. You are an effective leader who drives team engagement. For This Role, You Will Need: Minimum 10-12 years of experience in CAD, PLM, ERP tool Excellent verbal and written communication skills To manage the flow of job in such a way that the priorities are given due attention and the work is completed on time. To use CAD tool to create Drawings based on the standard and to maintain Drawing Database Good Engineering knowledge required to apply concepts in Valve operating system Engineering. Demonstrate ability to work in a team environment. Ability to drive change and effectively handle multiple priorities. Experience in planning, delegating and mentoring a team. Identifying & planning upskilling of team members apart from regular day-to-day functional deliverables by the team. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering or equivalent Proficiency in Solid Edge, Teamcenter or any other equivalent CAD/PLM Tools Experience in working any ERP Tool, Oracle preferred Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering or equivalent Proficiency in Solid Edge, Teamcenter or any other equivalent CAD/PLM Tools Experience in working any ERP Tool, Oracle preferred

Arsenal win again and Malen the main man in Italy as Roma score four once more
results.description: Arsenal beat Aston Villa 1-0 away from home to maintain its winning start to the Premier League while Barcelona and Roma preserved their perfect records in Spain and Italy with convincing wins on Monday. Osasuna beat Getafe 1-0 to continue its unbeaten start in La Liga, while Atalanta had to wait until the final minute to get the goal that beat Bologna in Serie A. Rampant Barcelona top La Liga Lamine Yamal and Raphinha both scored a brace and English winger Anthony Gordon grabbed two assists as Barcelona beat Rayo Vallecano 5-2 to record its 21st consecutive home victory. Rayo was looking for its first win of the season and it took an unexpected lead in the 12th minute when Sergio Camello hammered home a cutback from Álvaro García on the left. Barcelona, however, bounced back almost immediately and it was 2-1 up before the first period was even halfway over. Raphinha equalized with a well-taken goal in the 18th and Lamine Yamal put them ahead 90 seconds later with a characteristic move, cutting in from the right and unleashing a powerful left-foot shot into the roof of the net. Hansi Flick's men got a third after halftime when Florian Lejeune turned Gordon's cutback into his own net. Although the excellent Camello cut the deficit with a solid header, Raphinha soon made it 4-2 and Yamal rounded off the scoring with a low shot from just outside the box a minute from time. The win moved Barcelona above Real Madrid at the top of the league on goal difference. Rayo sat third from bottom. Malen keeps scoring for Roma In Serie A, Donyell Malen took his season tally to five in two games as Roma went to Lecce and won 4-0. Malen, who scored a hat trick in Roma's opening win over Fiorentina, had Roma 2-0 up midway through the first half, and Matias Soulé added a third before halftime. Rodrigo Mora completed the scoring 20 minutes into the second half as Roma established its title credentials early. The result, a second consecutive 4-0 win for the capital club, lifted Roma to the top of Serie A after two games. Later, Atalanta sneaked past Bologna thanks to a stoppage time goal from Lazar Samard?ić. Neither side convinced in an ordinary encounter and it wasn't until stoppage time that Samard?ić's long-range effort squirmed in past the Bologna goalkeeper. The result was harsh on Bologna and left it pointless after two games. Atalanta moved into the top five, one of six clubs with maximum points. Arsenal win on landmark night for Arteta In England, reigning champion Arsenal recorded a familiar 1-0 win as Bukayo Saka's 59th minute goal secured all three points at Aston Villa. Villa is suffering after a string of high-profile departures in recent weeks, and struggled to make an impact. It ended a second game in a row without recording a shot on target. Unai Emery's side was pointless after two games, while counterpart Mike Arteta celebrated his 250th Premier League match in the dugout for Arsenal. Arteta was content to see his side become one of only four English teams to take maximum points from their first two games.
